purpose: Exploratory localization of whole-caption vs individual-clause failure on four inspected common errors.
selection: First four seed-hash video errors shared by five baselines; chosen after P027. This is an exploratory diagnostic, not accuracy evaluation or a new reranker.

cases.caption: About three quarters of the bowl of chocolate chips are shown and you can see a hand about to reach towards that bowl.
clauses: About three quarters of the bowl of chocolate chips are shown.
A hand is about to reach towards the bowl of chocolate chips.

cases.caption: The door is open halfway and half of the person is visible.
clauses: Half of the person is visible.

cases.caption: There is a picture of a man.  He is glancing straight down and not looking off to either side.
clauses: The man is glancing straight down.
The man is not looking off to either side.

cases.caption: The man in the middle is leaning slightly forward with an outstretched arm and his mouth is open
clauses: The man in the middle is leaning slightly forward.
The man in the middle has an outstretched arm.
The man in the middle has his mouth open.

interpretation: Compare signed gold-vs-error margin for unchanged full description and manually separated necessary clauses. Favoring gold for an isolated clause does not prove a general aggregation failure; pair and prompts are post-hoc.
limits: Manual decompositions and only four error-selected questions; no generalization/statistical significance claim.
No new visual evidence is added; adjective thresholds and about-to temporal wording can still be ambiguous.
Raw margins from different clause prompts are not assumed calibrated or combined into a proposed method.
